Review of survey: The unit does not pass review as it stands. Every check runs green, and most interfaces and the story path work. Four things stand in the way, each reproduced or confirmed by mutation:

1. A checkpoint that hits a corrupt closure or a busy flush.lock exits 2 and leaves the lock held, because there is no finally around the release.
2. The survey does not refuse a hotfix cycle or a hub layout (D3). In a hotfix cycle it cuts the story branch from the integration branch.
3. A worktree directory removed outside git can never be recreated, because nothing runs 'worktree prune'.
4. A project path containing 'sandbox' makes ordinary git failures read as not_permitted, against ORDER rule 11.

There are also two process problems. Six ledger outcomes are marked fixed though only their story-path part was built; D33-21's delivery half, for one, has dropped out of G4a's list. And require_story's membership check has no test that can fail. Checked 36 promised interfaces, 31 as promised. Checked 11 outcomes: 5 confirmed, 5 confirmed only for the story path, and D33-21 not confirmed. 19 findings written to /Users/jmagady/dev2/vsdd-factory/rewrite/findings/sources/extra-step3-survey-review.json.. 19 findings, 6 blocker or major.
Round 1 for survey: 18 of 19 fixes confirmed, 2 still open.
Round 2 for survey: 2 of 2 fixes confirmed, 0 still open.

fix.summary: Fixed all 19 review findings in the step-3 survey unit (vsdd-factory 1.0, branch rewrite/v1). Majors: checkpoint's stops/closes/flush now ride in try/except with the release in finally (corrupt closure and StoreBusy give ok:false exit 1 with the lock freed and the run ended); survey story refuses exit 2 for hub layout, hotfix cycle and missing --subject; worktree adds prune first so by-hand removals no longer wedge re-admission, set_integration and detached; not_permitted classification requires git's own 'Operation not permitted' in stderr. Minors: require_story membership test (story_not_in_run), no-machine-path closure assertions, the D33-13 set-upstream command corrected and run by the test plus a not_descendant remedy that works, admitted_by='plan' from the survey, route row 15 args.decisions with preconditions.check as the runnable test, paths from classify_worktree with grammar-refusing story_path and policy-sourced criticality, no-cycle/--cycle/../x refusals, _gate faults rising to the survey at exit 1, empty run = partial, the two missing position tests, remove_story deleting the configured branch on retry, closure-record schema's delivery.branch described as the target branch, the P3BLD-23 sentences in records/run.md and commands/survey.md, closed written as the checkpoint's ISO stamp and said in records/closure.md. The six ledger entries marked fixed on half-built evidence (P3REQ-07, P3OPS-07, P3OPS-08, P3REQ-02, P3OPS-10, D33-21) were re-recorded as left-for-builder in rewrite/findings/outcomes/step3-survey-fix.json with the part done and the remainder's owning package, and findings.py build was rerun (G4a.md lists D33-21 again).
